children: Beeline announced its Bizumentary highlighting mortgage solutions for self-employed borrowers and property investors will premiere Sept. 24.
Premiere on Sept. 24 at 9 p.m. ET / 6 p.m. PT on BizTV, YouToo America, YTA TV and American Forces Network.
Production created with Emmy Award-winning Loft 100 Studios to showcase Beeline’s mortgage solutions.
Targets self-employed borrowers and property investors, two key markets served by Beeline.
Post-premiere distribution across Apple Podcasts, Spotify, iHeartRadio, YouTube and other digital platforms.
Scheduled to air weekly after premiere, with potential for broader network distribution as exposure grows.

title: Beeline’s Bizumentary to Premiere Sept. 24 on National and Digital Platforms
